method: Human-authorized tenth verification round for stage4 (Jaden, 2026-10-10: 'run a fresh independent verifier round for the behavior research stages'; re-sample after fixing mismatches; 2026-10-11: budget-friendly path approved). Before this round, origin/main #59 and #63 were merged (D075 pin-level models re-sourced OHM-122 to OHM-126 and OHM-131), and the three mismatches the refreshed reviews of OHM-126 and OHM-131 found were fixed against the archived documents: the FT/TTa/NRST input-threshold scopes in OHM-124, OHM-125 and OHM-126 now give DS8626 Rev 12 Table 48's 1.7 V <= VDD <= 3.6 V condition (1.75 V belongs to the BOOT0 rows), and OHM-131's 5 V tolerant list adds PA14 (pin 37) and PB3 (pin 39), which DS5319 Rev 20 Table 5 marks FT. New integer seed drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the sample was computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry (Claude Sonnet, chosen for cost) with the unchanged round-7 instructions: text extraction with word coordinates first, at most four cropped renders at 150 dpi or less, and spot checks of digitized curve points instead of full re-digitization. Reviewers read only the entry gapfill, its generated record, FETCH_LEDGER.jsonl (URL-to-SHA256 mapping only) and the archived primary-source bytes; no web access, no other repository files, no prior verifier reports. Values, units, conditions, min/typ/max qualifiers, document metadata and provenance claims were re-derived; page-citation drift with the value present elsewhere in the same document is recorded as a note.
